leadText:
----
 
(Japanese: Pokémon Frienda: Teach Me, Friender-Man!) is a Pokémon manga by Kemon Kawamoto. It is serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine, with the first chapter published in the September 2024 issue, released on July 20, 2024. It is based on the arcade game Pokémon Frienda. It tells the story of Renda Tomoda and Friender-Man.
